title: TR.------PROG.CONT.
description: Chart on book p. 469 (TRF(II)-5). TR (transformation) is the subject; PROG-CONT (progressional continuance) is the partner. From the subject: PART (participation), RT-DY (reality dynamics) and TH-CONT-IMP. From PART: OP-SPD (option spread). From RT-DY: SOC-RT-P (social reality particular). From TH-CONT-IMP: AFL-DY (affinity dynamics) and C-INFO (composite information). From C-INFO: LK-IMP (linkage implications). From LK-IMP: INFO-RSOLD. From INFO-RSOLD: LANG-DY (language dynamics). From LANG-DY: IST-S-ALGN (isolated systematic alignment).
